name: Pilar de la Horadada (Spain)
description: Vertically divided red and green, with a yellow tower on the red and a white column bearing a red cross of Santiago on the green, the figures of the municipal arms of Pilar de la Horadada.
history: The flag is a rectangle of proportions 2:3 parted per pale and contains the most representative elements and colours of the arms, red and green.

features.role: column with a red cross of Santiago
